messages:
kate: Quick thread to finalize customer comms follow-ups from the postmortem. Need owners, deliverables, and RCA request flow. Keep replies tight.
sam: Goal: single voice for status page + outreach. 7 business day RCA promise.
maria: Legal: public summary + commit to RCA within 7 business days. Full internal RCA shared on request under data-sharing addendum. We'll supply a redacted internal RCA by default.
raj: Ops: I'll update remediation tracker and add a recurrence-evidence section for similar incidents in the last 60 days. ETA Tue AM.
oliver: I'll prepare two outreach templates: top-tier (personalized + offer call) and broadcast. Need final status copy to match tone.
support-bot: Support flow: request -> support@ -> ticket auto-tag incident-rca -> PSA routes to comms/legal. SLA: acknowledge within 2 business days.
kate: Elaine? (or whoever) can someone draft status page copy + 72h public digest?
sam: Elaine can do it. Elaine: status page by Thu EOD; 72h digest Fri AM. Sam reviews before send.
maria: I'll add a short intake template for support to collect purpose, artifacts requested, and contact.
raj: I'll pre-generate a redacted-RCA template (no raw traces) for faster share; full logs only with addendum. Spike by next Tue.
oliver: Outreach plan: top 5 get 1:1 template + invite to 30-min call; others get broadcast + link + option to request full RCA. Draft Thu AM.
kate: Action summary: 1) Status page copy - owner: elaine - Thu EOD. 2) 72h public digest - owner: elaine - Fri AM. 3) Remediation tracker + recurrence notes - owner: raj - Tue AM. 4) RCA sharing wording & intake - owner: maria - Wed EOB. 5) Outreach templates - owner: oliver - Thu AM. 6) Support SLA & canned reply - owner: support - Thu EOD.
support-bot: Reminders set. Please update remediation tracker with links to drafts so sam can approve.
sam: Ping me when drafts are in staging. We'll close once status copy is staged and outreach drafts exist.
